content.title: THE BODY PARTS MOST PEOPLE FORGET TO FEED PROPERLY
facts: **Gallbladder** - Beets, Radishes, Olive oil: bitter compounds in radishes and beets help keep bile flowing smoothly instead of thickening into sludge.
**Pancreas** - Spinach, Blueberries, Greek yogurt: this trio eases the workload on insulin-producing cells instead of spiking them into overdrive.
**Bladder** - Cranberries, Cucumber, Watermelon: these hydrate and discourage bacteria from clinging to the lining.
**Adrenal glands** - Avocado, Pistachios, Oranges: they help buffer the stress-hormone rollercoaster instead of leaving you wired and crashing.
**Bone marrow** - Beef liver, Pumpkin seeds, Lentils: iron and zinc-rich foods fuel where your red blood cells are actually made.
**Lymphatic system** - Garlic, Citrus, Turmeric: these support your body's quiet drainage network that flushes out waste between cells.
**Joints/cartilage** - Bone broth, Salmon, Cherries: collagen-building and anti-inflammatory foods that cushion movement instead of letting it wear down.
**Follow along** - for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
A few of these deserve extra attention. Radishes contain compounds that stimulate bile production, which helps your gallbladder break down fat instead of letting it stagnate and form stones over time. Pistachios are one of the few nuts that actually lower cortisol response during stressful moments, giving your adrenal glands a break instead of keeping them in constant overdrive. And cherries, especially tart ones, contain natural compounds that calm inflammation around joints, which is why some people notice less morning stiffness when they eat them regularly. Everyone's body responds differently, so pay attention to what works for you.
